content: this is a summary of a civil case that took place in the marijampolė district court the specific details of the case and the parties involved are not provided the applicant paid €600 for professional fees while the defendant paid various fees and professional fees totaling €20170 the court decided to dissolve the marriage and awarded the defendant certain properties including buildings and vehicles the applicant was awarded a car the court also ordered the defendant to pay the applicant compensation of €257762 the court discussed various articles of the civil code related to matrimonial property the applicant is seeking the dissolution of their marriage and the division of various properties the court must determine the date of separation and decide on the division of property and allocation of costs the court has allowed the request to dissolve the marriage and has awarded certain properties to the defendant the defendant has been ordered to pay compensation to the applicant the liability of a credit agreement between the parties will remain joint the applicant has been ordered to pay part of the lawyers costs and the defendant has been ordered to pay the state costs of the proceedings
